entries.dialogueText: "With the public's faith in the Crown restored thanks to Your Majesty's generosity, the Rizian National Coalition is working on proposals to ensure no further unpleasantness."

entries.title: Narrator: ""With the traitors among us subdued..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the traitors among us subdued and peace restored, the RNC is working on proposals to ensure no such further unpleasantness occurs."

entries.dialogueText: "With their majority in the House of Delegates unchallenged, the RNC continues to lobby for greater protections for the Rizian noblility."

entries.title: Narrator: ""In the wake of the exceptional gen..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the wake of the exceptional generosity shown by the Crown during the nationwide riots, the RPP has abandoned its goal of constitutional reform for the time being."

entries.title: Narrator: ""Following your firm crackdown on t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Following your firm crackdown on the national unrest, the RPP lies in disarray, their inability to implement meaningful reforms leaving them powerless and irrelevant to a silent populace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite a lack of public support,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite a lack of public support, the RPP remains determined to push for reforms aimed at modernizing Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""After eight years, Rizia's economy..."
entries.dialogueText: "After eight years, Rizia's economy is robust and diverse. Resources like gas and gold have diminished in importance compared to growing sectors like manufacturing, services, and technology."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""After eight years of your reign, R..."
entries.dialogueText: "After eight years of your reign, Rizia's economy is a balanced mix of resources and other traditional sectors such as manufacturing and agriculture. We may be falling behind where innovation is concerned, but we are protected from global price fluctuations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite your stated intentions at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite your stated intentions at the beginning of your reign, our economy is still heavily dependent on resources such as gas and gold."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We have the Crown's positive relat..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have the Crown's positive relationship with the Rizian business community to thank for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the report related to e..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the report related to economics and energy.
entries.menuText: Economy and Energy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As for energy, the sector is thriv..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for energy, the sector is thriving, easily fuelling our industries while satisfying our trade partners' demands."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As for energy, our output remains..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for energy, our output remains stable, supporting essential programs and investments."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As for energy, the sector is strug..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for energy, the sector is struggling, and production is underperforming."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In terms of budget, our treasury i..."
entries.dialogueText: "In terms of budget, our treasury is overflowing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In terms of budget, our treasury r..."
entries.dialogueText: "In terms of budget, our treasury remains balanced."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In terms of the budget, our pocket..."
entries.dialogueText: "In terms of the budget, our pockets are empty, so to speak."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In terms of the budget, we are run..."
entries.dialogueText: "In terms of the budget, we are running into the negative."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Over 50% of Rizians own television..."
entries.dialogueText: "Over 50% of Rizians own televisions, many households have air conditioning, and weekend trips and dining out are a regular luxury for many."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Water shortages have become routin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Water shortages have become routine, food prices have soared beyond reach for many, and failing clinics and emptying classrooms leave little hope for relief."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Over 70% of Rizians own television..."
entries.dialogueText: "Over 70% of Rizians own televisions, approximately half of all homes have air conditioning, and weekend getaways and dining out have become routine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""While the nobility continues to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the nobility continues to be able to afford luxuries such as televisions, restaurant meals and vacations, the common Rizian rarely enjoys such privileges."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""While the nobility continues to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the nobility continues to be able to afford luxuries such as televisions, restaurant meals and vacations, the common Rizian does not enjoy such privileges."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Water shortages are now commonplac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Water shortages are now commonplace, food prices have risen to unaffordable levels for many, and struggling clinics along with dwindling classrooms offer little hope for improvement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This concludes the report. Signed,..."
entries.dialogueText: "This concludes the report. Signed, Daria de Rava, Councilor of the Treasury and Economics."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""That about wraps things up. Signed..."
entries.dialogueText: "That about wraps things up. Signed, Russello Montoro, Councilor of the Treasury and Economics."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Signed, Elena Werner, Councilor of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Signed, Elena Werner, Councilor of the Treasury and Economics."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to construct massive tida..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to construct massive tidal generators along Rizia’s coastlines to harness the relentless power of the ocean and secure a steady energy source for the nation.
entries.menuText: Construct massive tidal generators along Rizia’s coastlines to harness the power of the ocean.  [-6 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Comfort breeds loyalty. They live..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comfort breeds loyalty. They live well under my rule.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“A disappointment, but not beyond c..."
entries.dialogueText: “A disappointment, but not beyond correction.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I build a kingdom, yet they strugg..."
entries.dialogueText: “I build a kingdom, yet they struggle to enjoy its bounty. A failure that must be corrected.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“A predictable outcome.”"
entries.dialogueText: “A predictable outcome.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“They squander the opportunities I..."
entries.dialogueText: “They squander the opportunities I provide. The Crown is not to blame.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Order and prosperity -- proof of m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Order and prosperity -- proof of my rule.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Could be worse, but at least the b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Could be worse, but at least the breadlines aren't back."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I set the report aside, contemplati..."
entries.dialogueText: I set the report aside, contemplating over what I'd just read.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have the pieces before me -- now..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have the pieces before me -- now, to set them in motion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need to approach my next steps w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need to approach my next steps wisely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It’s tempting to make a move, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s tempting to make a move, but not every problem requires a hasty solution. I’ll hold off for now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided not to take any further a..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided not to take any further actions regarding our economy or energy situation.
entries.menuText: Do nothing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In terms of budget, our treasury i..."
entries.dialogueText: "In terms of budget, our treasury is in good shape."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With low expenditure and high inco..."
entries.dialogueText: "With low expenditure and high income, we can comfortably embark on large investment projects without facing debt."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With income and expenditures healt..."
entries.dialogueText: "With income and expenditures healthily balanced, we are set to maintain a budget surplus for years to come, though caution should be exercised when embarking on large investment projects."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, with limited income and m..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, with limited income and many outgoing expenses, the government is facing serious constraints."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, the government is facing..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the government is facing a deficit, requiring significant borrowing to cover essential costs, which raises concerns about long-term financial stability."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, thanks to low expenditure..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, thanks to low expenditure and strategic investments, we have set the stage for future growth."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, we maintain fiscal respon..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, we maintain fiscal responsibility through moderate growth and careful investments."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With limited resources and a focus..."
entries.dialogueText: "With limited resources and a focus on essential expenses, the government is facing constraints, making it difficult to allocate funds for larger projects."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The government's expenditures heav..."
entries.dialogueText: "The government's expenditures heavily outweigh our incoming funds. If no action is taken to balance our budget, we may be headed into a financial crisis."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Critics say we're putting too much..."
entries.dialogueText: "Critics say we're putting too much power in the hands of corporations -- I say screw 'em."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""They suggest a massive cultural ef..."
entries.dialogueText: "They suggest a massive cultural effort, one that will etch a positive impression of the monarchy into the hearts and minds of every Rizian who may still be unconvinced."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""At the same time, Speaker de Rava..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the same time, Speaker de Rava laments the destruction of property that occurred during the protests and advocates for greater protections for the noble classes and their estates."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Such measures should be paired wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such measures should be paired with a massive cultural effort, one that will remind citizens of the benevolence of the Royal Family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We will soon see a batch of new de..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will soon see a batch of new delegates elected from Pales, who we expect will align with the RNC."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Meanwhile, the Zillean part of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, the Zillean part of our population is expected to lean towards the RPP, possibly challenging the RNC's majority in the next elections."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, House Speaker Sazon inten..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, House Speaker Sazon intends to leverage his party's successes to demand further social welfare measures."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With both Manus Sazon and Adarfo S..."
entries.dialogueText: "With both Manus Sazon and Adarfo Sotelato out of the picture, leadership struggles threaten to tear the party apart completely."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Manus Sazon has returned to his ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus Sazon has returned to his role as House Speaker, and is focusing his attention on restoring unity to the party."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""House Speaker Sotelato is still ad..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Speaker Sotelato is still advocating for proposals that advance the rights of commoners, funded by steep taxes on the nobility."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""House Speaker Sazon is still advoc..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Speaker Sazon is still advocating for greater freedoms for commoners."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The Zillean part of our population..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Zillean part of our population is expected to lean towards the RPP, strengthening its majority."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, the upcoming elections wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the upcoming elections will see a batch of new delegates from Pales, many of whom are expected to align with the RNC."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""And with the recent unrest calmed..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with the recent unrest calmed by virtue of the Crown's generosity, we have seen little backlash from the public."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""And with most of the Crown's oppon..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with most of the Crown's opponents neutralized in the wake of the recent unrest, we have seen little if any backlash from the public."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Any public backlash has been muted..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any public backlash has been muted, thanks to the swift and effective intervention of our national security forces."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This is just the beginning, you kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is just the beginning, you know. If we keep opening Rizia's markets up to the world, there's no telling how rich we'll get."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Just look at how well the PDSE is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just look at how well the PDSE is doing! It's proof of the world's confidence in us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I've already reached out to Arcasi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already reached out to Arcasia's economic ministry. They see plenty of investment potential."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With regard to the provinces...""
entries.dialogueText: "With regard to the provinces..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Princess Vina's presence in Monqiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Princess Vina's presence in Monqiz has greatly assuaged fears in Valenqiris. The populace feels they have retained the Crown's favor, despite the departure of the rest of the Toras leadership."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Some in Valenqiris do refuse to sw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some in Valenqiris do refuse to swear fealty to the Crown out of loyalty to Vina, their former Duchess, who has yet to voice her support for the transition."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The public has shown little concer..."
entries.dialogueText: "The public has shown little concern, viewing the change as merely one name replacing another."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The former Duke Hubertus has stepp..."
entries.dialogueText: "The former Duke Hubertus has stepped aside gracefully, encouraging the public to respect their new leadership."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""A small minority of Cardesse-Monta..."
entries.dialogueText: "A small minority of Cardesse-Montaklar inhabitants refuse to acknowledge their new rulers out of solidarity with their deceased former Duchess."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""A small minority of Cardesse-Monta..."
entries.dialogueText: "A small minority of Cardesse-Montaklar inhabitants refuse to acknowledge their new rulers out of solidarity with the deceased General Taddeus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""General Carlos Azaro has been work..."
entries.dialogueText: "General Carlos Azaro has been working closely with his province's interim rulers to ensure no one notices any interruptions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Riots have once again erupted in I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Riots have once again erupted in Iza with Duchess Sazon's removal from power. But the rest of Brenas is ours to command."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With no strong leader in Brenas, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "With no strong leader in Brenas, the House Sazon loyalists capitulated very quickly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Angelica Sazon's loyalists held ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Angelica Sazon's loyalists held out for some time, but eventually capitulated under pressure from Countess Leona."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As for our remaining lands...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for our remaining lands..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As your Grand Vizier, I remind you..."
entries.dialogueText: "As your Grand Vizier, I remind you that the Province of Pales is willing and able to cooperate with the Rizian Crown. There is no need for such actions with us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With all three provinces under the..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all three provinces under the King's hand, no Dukes or Duchesses can interfere with God's plans for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We do recommend that more be done..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do recommend that more be done to tighten the monarchy's hold on these lands. Direct rule over all three provinces without the assistance of a Grand Vizier is no easy task."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Very sincerely, Duke Axel Reinhart.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very sincerely, Duke Axel Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With Nur's blessings, Sal Ignacius.""
entries.dialogueText: "With Nur's blessings, Sal Ignacius."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Signed by the Royal Council.""
entries.dialogueText: "Signed by the Royal Council."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The Azaros were less than pleased..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros were less than pleased with your choice of successor, to put it mildly. However, Queen Consort Lucita has spoken to her relations and believes they will accept Her Highness as heiress eventually."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With their family set to become pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "With their family set to become part of Rizia's ruling dynasty, the Azaros are now firmly in alliance with the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Though the Azaros have had complai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though the Azaros have had complaints about your reign, they remain firmly allied with the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The Azaros remain loyal allies of..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros remain loyal allies of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With their place in the royal line..."
entries.dialogueText: "With their place in the royal lineage secured, House Sazon will be giving us no trouble in the future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""House Sazon is understandably angr..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon is understandably angry about losing its place in the royal lineage. But they have no power to do anything about it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""House Sazon opposes most of your p..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon opposes most of your policies, but they don't have the power to do anything about it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The days of House Sazon giving us..."
entries.dialogueText: "The days of House Sazon giving us trouble are definitively over."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Your relatives in Valenqiris are t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your relatives in Valenqiris are thrilled to know that House Toras will hold the throne for at least another generation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Your relatives in Valenqiris were..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your relatives in Valenqiris were angered by Princess Vina's disinheritance, but ultimately, as the next heir to the throne will bear the Toras name, it makes little difference."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Your relatives in Valenqiris are d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your relatives in Valenqiris are disappointed that your successor will not bear the Toras name, though of course they will accept Princess Vina as their future queen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Your relatives in Valenqiris are t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your relatives in Valenqiris are thrilled to know that the next heir to the throne will bear the Toras name."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Some Torases in Valenqiris are rum..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some Torases in Valenqiris are rumored to be rallying against you. There is no sign of an immediate threat, but it is worth keeping any eye on them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""No matter the future of your reign..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter the future of your reign, House Toras will support you as steadfastly as always."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Your humble servant, Hugo Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your humble servant, Hugo Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Not like that's a bad thing. But w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not like that's a bad thing. But we could be doing more to step up innovation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Unfortunately, we are in the throe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we are in the throes of an energy crisis that threatens to erase whatever progress we've made."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In keeping with your intentions, o..."
entries.dialogueText: "In keeping with your intentions, our economy is still heavily dependent on resources such as gas and gold."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our economic growth has led to a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our economic growth has led to a surge of new businesses, from factories to neighborhood restaurants."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our economic growth has led to a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our economic growth has led to a steady rise in new businesses, from neighborhood stores to family-run restaurants."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite our growing budget, we're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite our growing budget, we're seeing a slowdown in new businesses, with many entrepreneurs forced to close their doors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite our growing budget, we're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite our growing budget, we're seeing a collapse in the business sector, with numerous empty storefronts across the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With that said, the investments we..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that said, the investments we've made have led to a surge of new businesses, from factories to neighborhood restaurants."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With that said, the investments we..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that said, the investments we've made have led to a steady rise in new businesses, from neighborhood stores to family-run restaurants."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our shrinking budget is coupled wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our shrinking budget is coupled with a slowdown in new businesses, with many entrepreneurs forced to close their doors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our shrinking budget is coupled wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our shrinking budget is coupled with a collapse in the business sector, with numerous empty storefronts across the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Amid this corporate renaissance, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Amid this corporate renaissance, we must make sure Rizia's traditional, family-run businesses do not get run out of town by newer, foreign-influenced competitors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Amid our flourishing business clim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Amid our flourishing business climate, we must take care to uplift the citizenry and nobility alike."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Greater cooperation between the Cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Greater cooperation between the Crown and the Rizian business community will only compound this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This despite the Crown's positive..."
entries.dialogueText: "This despite the Crown's positive relationship with the Rizian business community."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The Crown's deteriorating relation..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown's deteriorating relationship with the Rizian business community has not helped matters."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Looking to the future, we are expe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking to the future, we are expected to continue running an energy surplus, enabling us to meet our partners' demands while seeking new frontiers at home and abroad."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Looking to the future, we are expe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking to the future, we are expected to continue running a slim energy surplus, though new sources will be needed should we wish to embark on more ambitious projects."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Looking to the future, however, de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking to the future, however, demand is expected to outstrip supply. We must either cut our energy expenditures or seek out new sources."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Yet this seems to only be a tempor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet this seems to only be a temporary setback. If energy expenditures are kept low, our stores are set to rebound over the next several years."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Yet this seems to only be a tempor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet this seems to only be a temporary setback. If energy expenditures are kept low, our stores are set to rebound over the next five years."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our demand for fuel drastically ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our demand for fuel drastically outstrips our supply. We must either cut our energy expenditures or seek out new sources."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Without the necessary reforms, man..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without the necessary reforms, many companies complain of stifled innovation and an inability to compete globally."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As it is, many companies complain..."
entries.dialogueText: "As it is, many companies complain of stifled innovation and an inability to compete globally."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Give them a helping hand, and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give them a helping hand, and the sky's the limit for us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We should make an attempt to aid R..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should make an attempt to aid Rizia's traditional, family-run businesses while limiting the powers of foreign-influenced competitors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Intervention by the Crown is warra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Intervention by the Crown is warranted, though we must make sure our citizenry is not left behind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We'll never bounce back unless we..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll never bounce back unless we give them a helping hand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We should make an attempt to aid R..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should make an attempt to aid Rizia's traditional, family-run businesses while limiting the powers of foreign-influenced competitors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Intervention by the Crown is warra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Intervention by the Crown is warranted, though we must make sure our citizenry is not left behind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I say give it time. Let business o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I say give it time. Let business owners do their thing, and we'll bounce back eventually."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I believe Rizia's traditional, fam..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe Rizia's traditional, family-run businesses are being sidelined in favor of newer, foreign-influenced competitors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Aiding large corporations has done..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aiding large corporations has done little to prevent job loss. Another method must be found."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Fortunately, the economic downturn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, the economic downturn has not yet had an impact on Rizia's excellent living standards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our economic health has led to liv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our economic health has led to living standards that are far above the Merkopan average."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite our poor economic health,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite our poor economic health, living standards have not yet significantly declined."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our economic good health has yet t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our economic good health has yet to reflect itself in Rizian living standards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Unfortunately, our poor economic h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, our poor economic health has led to a decline in living standards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Puzzlingly, despite the rise in ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Puzzlingly, despite the rise in new businesses, Rizian living standards are suffering."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""If we are to raise living standard..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we are to raise living standards, we must remember that a rising tide lifts all boats. Grant Rizia's noble stewards greater economic freedoms, and the populace will reap the rewards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Though we are doing well, I believ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though we are doing well, I believe we can reach still greater heights. Grant Rizia's noble stewards more economic freedoms, and the populace will reap the rewards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I'm sure that if we keep opening R..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure that if we keep opening Rizia's markets up to the world, our current economic woes will be a thing of the past."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Lespia and ATO are off the table,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and ATO are off the table, obviously. But we don't need them to thrive."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With our people's needs covered an..."
entries.dialogueText: "With our people's needs covered and then some, we have a comfortable base from which to expand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Meeting the populace's needs shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meeting the populace's needs should be our number one goal going forward. Economic expansion can wait."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The PDSE got off to a slow start,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The PDSE got off to a slow start, it's true, but that just means it's a great time for folks to buy in."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Giving domestic investors greater..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving domestic investors greater incentives to participate in the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange could be a good start."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Giving domestic investors early bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving domestic investors early buying privileges in the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange could be a good start."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The subpar performance of our stoc..."
entries.dialogueText: "The subpar performance of our stock exchange is proof that we can and should do better."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The success of the Porte Drazon St..."
entries.dialogueText: "The success of the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange is proof of Rizia's potential. We must rise to meet expectations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "I closed the binder and picked up m..."
entries.dialogueText: I closed the binder and picked up my pen.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to grow the national budg..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to grow the national budget by making every Rizian citizen legally obligated to buy shares in the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange.
entries.menuText: Grow your budget by making every Rizian citizen legally obligated to buy shares in the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With the abolishment of the House..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the abolishment of the House of Delegates, noble and common Rizians alike complain of a lack of representation in government."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Together with the heads of several..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together with the heads of several lesser noble families, ex-House Speaker Daria de Rava has formed the Patricians' Council, a lobbying group that will submit their most pressing concerns to the Royal Council every six months."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Ex-House Speaker Manus Sazon and o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ex-House Speaker Manus Sazon and other ex-RPP members have formed the Rizian Liberties Union, an organization that provides legal assistance to Rizians facing 'unjust persecution', though its charter does not mention the Royal Family by name."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We have seen little activity among..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have seen little activity among former members. Whatever's left of the reform movement seems to have gone underground."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""While the History Museum has impro..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the History Museum has improved regional perception of the monarchy, more efforts are advised to reassure the public that the Crown cares for them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""While the new boarding school will..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the new boarding school will eventually lead to a positive perception of the monarchy among provincial nobles, more efforts are advised to reassure the public that the Crown cares for them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""While no further uprisings are in..."
entries.dialogueText: "While no further uprisings are in our immediate future, more efforts are advised to reassure the public that the Crown cares for them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I launched a kingdom-wide scientifi..."
entries.dialogueText: I launched a kingdom-wide scientific research initiative, placing the monarchy at its core to reinforce our family’s legacy for generations.
entries.menuText: Launch a kingdom-wide scientific research initiative, ensuring that new treatments and cures have the Royal Family's name attached to them. [-5 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to commission an exhausti..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to commission an exhaustive survey to uncover Rizia's remaining resources, at possible detriment to citizens' living standards and the environment.
entries.menuText: Commission an exhaustive, kingdom-wide survey for resources, at possible detriment to citizens' living standards and the environment.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This is not yet taking into accoun..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not yet taking into account the potential of Zille's remaining resources, which have yet to be unearthed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to mass-print guilders, k..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to mass-print guilders, knowing it would cause hyperinflation, but it would cover our debts, at least for now.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to reach out to Intermerk..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to reach out to Intermerkopum for a loan, despite the risk of indebting us further in the long term.
entries.menuText: Request a loan from your fellow Intermerkopum countries.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to seize excess funds bey..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to seize excess funds beyond 10,000 guilders from each Rizian citizen’s bank account, to be repaid over 30 years, though it would undoubtedly stir significant backlash.
entries.menuText: Seize excess funds beyond 10,000 guilders from each Rizian citizen’s personal bank account.

entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to apply for a loan from..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to apply for a loan from the MFI, despite the risk of indebting us further in the long term.
entries.menuText: Apply for a loan from the Multinational Finance Institution (MFI), the Alliance of Nation's primary financial agency.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With the provinces' security alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the provinces' security already under Crown control, the transition has been a smooth one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With the leadership of Valenqiris..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the leadership of Valenqiris and Brenas already out of the noble houses' hands, the transition has been a smooth one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
